description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): atelier-pr4k's change (4b300310), which makes --quiet print one documented token on every command. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 33, atelier-fnak): a refused quiet start or issue transition still prints the whole transition report on stdout. The reviewer of atelier-k5gi, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
